subject.title: feat(apple): copy or save rendered widgets as images from the chat transcript

question: Should OpenClaw adopt native image-export actions for rendered transcript widgets on both iOS and macOS once the filename boundary and signed-app proof are addressed?
rationale: This adds a durable user-visible Apple transcript capability, and the protected `maintainer` label means the product surface should be explicitly sponsored rather than inferred from a technically plausible implementation.

options.title: Sponsor the native export feature
options.body: Accept the iOS and macOS interaction model after the filename repair and direct runtime proof demonstrate the intended user flow.

options.title: Narrow the initial surface
options.body: Approve only one platform or one export action first if the long-press/right-click menu expansion is broader than the desired transcript UX.

options.title: Defer the feature
options.body: Pause this PR if widget export should be designed alongside the separate web export workstream rather than added independently.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the native export feature
recommendation.body: Accept the iOS and macOS interaction model after the filename repair and direct runtime proof demonstrate the intended user flow.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied provenance connects steipete directly to the proposed Apple UI implementation; broader current-main ownership history was not available.
